fun_facts: Legend says the nets came with traders from the court of Kublai Khan.

Watch one full lower–lift cycle, not just the photo
Look for the catch-sorting on the shore mat
pois.summary: Iconic cantilever shore nets, still fished daily at high tide.

fun_facts: The promenade faces due west — sunsets drop straight into the sea.

Find the fish-auction sheds behind the nets

Read the old gravestones along the side wall

Step out front: compare spires with St. Francis nearby
pois.summary: White basilica with painted ceilings, minutes from St. Francis.

Find the British-era additions at the far end

pois.history: Heritage residential street lined with Portuguese, Dutch and British-era houses.
pois.name: Princess Street

pois.summary: Heritage house-lined street, best walked slowly.

pois.history: 19th-century merchant bungalow of the Pierce Leslie trading company.

see_list: View the harbour-facing verandah from the lane
Note the laterite-and-wood construction
Find the old company marker near the gate

fun_facts: The Koder family were prominent Cochin merchants and patrons.

pois.history: Early-1900s merchant mansion of the Koder family, kept in period style.
pois.name: Koder House
see_list: Admire the red-brick facade from across the street
Note the wooden upper verandah
Find the family crest marker
pois.summary: Red-brick merchant mansion, exterior landmark.

Check the photography corner rules before shooting

pois.name: Bishop's House
see_list: View the facade from the museum lane
Note the compound wall and old gate
Respect the private residence boards

pois.history: 16th-century palace of the Kochi Rajas, renovated by the Dutch; known for its murals and royal artefacts.

Ask which rooms are closed this week

pois.history: Historic synagogue of the Cochin Jewish community in Jew Town, rebuilt in the 1700s.
pois.name: Pardesi Synagogue
see_list: Look down: the Chinese-tile floor
Find the old-clock tower outside
Read the community history plaques

Check the outdoor gun and anchor display

Look for carnival-route markers on walls
